verdict.rationale: ClickUp's integrations directory claims connectivity to "1,000+ tools" for free. It lists many first-party integrations with real sync depth: Slack, GitHub, GitLab, HubSpot, Figma, Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, Sentry and Calendly. It also offers bridges like n8n to connect to any app. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the directory's breadth and quality, and evidence of 'thousands' rather than the claimed 1,000+.
